messages.snippet: All, The document management system (NetDocs) will be unavailable this Saturday 14 March from 22:00
messages.subject: [Action] DMS maintenance window — Saturday 14 March, 22:00–02:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system (NetDocs) will be unavailable this Saturday 14 March from 22:00 to 02:00 for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any documents you have open before 21:30. Email and the time-recording system are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
